### Complete Basic Example

Here's the complete basic example:

```go
package main

import (
    "context"
    "fmt"
    "log"

    "github.com/digitallysavvy/go-ai/pkg/ai"
    "github.com/digitallysavvy/go-ai/pkg/providers/anthropic"
)

func main() {
    // Create client
    client := newExampleClient(
        "your-api-key",
        exampleWithProvider(anthropic.NewProvider()),
    )

    // Create request
    request := ai.GenerateTextOptions{
        Model: "claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022",
        Messages: []types.Message{
            {Role: "user", Content: "Hello, world!"},
        },
    }

    // Generate response
    response, err := ai.GenerateText(context.Background(), request)
    if err != nil {
        log.Fatalf("Error: %v", err)
    }

    // Display result
    fmt.Printf("Response: %s\n", response.Content)
}
```

### 4. Error Handling

Always implement proper error handling:

```go
response, err := ai.GenerateText(ctx, request)
if err != nil {
    // Check for specific error types
    if providererrors.IsRateLimitError(err) {
        // Handle rate limiting
        log.Println("Rate limited, implementing backoff")
        time.Sleep(5 * time.Second)
        // Retry logic
    } else if errors.Is(err, providererrors.ErrInvalidInput) {
        // Handle validation errors
        return fmt.Errorf("invalid input: %w", err)
    } else {
        // Handle other errors
        return fmt.Errorf("generation failed: %w", err)
    }
}
```

### 5. Resource Management

Properly manage resources:

```go
// Use defer for cleanup
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
defer cancel()

// Close streams when done
stream, err := ai.StreamText(ctx, request)
if err != nil {
    return err
}
defer stream.Close()
```

### Error Handling Pattern

Complete error handling pattern for this feature:

```go
func handleRequest(request ai.GenerateTextOptions) error {
    ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
    defer cancel()

    response, err := ai.GenerateText(ctx, request)
    if err != nil {
        // Handle different error types
        switch {
        case providererrors.IsRateLimitError(err):
            return handleRateLimit(request)
        case errors.Is(err, providererrors.ErrInvalidInput):
            return fmt.Errorf("invalid request: %w", err)
        case errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded):
            return fmt.Errorf("request timed out: %w", err)
        default:
            return fmt.Errorf("generation failed: %w", err)
        }
    }

    // Process successful response
    processResponse(response)
    return nil
}

func handleRateLimit(request ai.GenerateTextOptions) error {
    // Implement exponential backoff
    backoff := time.Second
    maxRetries := 3

    for i := 0; i < maxRetries; i++ {
        time.Sleep(backoff)
        response, err := ai.GenerateText(context.Background(), request)
        if err == nil {
            processResponse(response)
            return nil
        }
        if !providererrors.IsRateLimitError(err) {
            return err
        }
        backoff *= 2
    }

    return fmt.Errorf("max retries exceeded")
}
        backoff *= 2
    }

    return fmt.Errorf("max retries exceeded")
}
```

## Real-World Example

Complete, production-ready example:

```go
package main

import (
    "context"
    "errors"
    "fmt"
    "log"
    "os"
    "time"

    "github.com/digitallysavvy/go-ai/pkg/ai"
    "github.com/digitallysavvy/go-ai/pkg/providers/anthropic"
)

func main() {
    // Initialize client with production settings
    apiKey := os.Getenv("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY")
    if apiKey == "" {
        log.Fatal("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY not set")
    }

    client := newExampleClient(
        apiKey,
        exampleWithProvider(anthropic.NewProvider()),
        exampleWithTimeout(60*time.Second),
    )

    // Execute task with error handling
    if err := executeTask(client); err != nil {
        log.Fatalf("Task failed: %v", err)
    }

    log.Println("Task completed successfully")
}

func executeTask(model provider.LanguageModel) error {
    ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
    defer cancel()

    request := ai.GenerateTextOptions{
        Model: model,
        Messages: []types.Message{
            {
                Role:    "system",
                Content: "You are a helpful assistant.",
            },
            {
                Role:    "user",
                Content: "Explain the concept briefly.",
            },
        },
        Temperature: ptr(0.7),
        MaxTokens:   ptr(1000),
    }

    response, err := ai.GenerateText(ctx, request)
    if err != nil {
        return handleError(err)
    }

    fmt.Printf("Response:\n%s\n", response.Content)
    fmt.Printf("Tokens used: %d\n", response.Usage.GetTotalTokens())

    return nil
}

func handleError(err error) error {
    switch {
    case providererrors.IsRateLimitError(err):
        return fmt.Errorf("rate limited, try again later: %w", err)
    case errors.Is(err, providererrors.ErrInvalidInput):
        return fmt.Errorf("invalid input: %w", err)
    case errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded):
        return fmt.Errorf("request timed out: %w", err)
    default:
        return fmt.Errorf("generation failed: %w", err)
    }
}
```
